correctness.rationale: Using p_b(bq+t)=0 for t<b-1 and p_b(bq+b-1)=1-p_b(q), any word starting or ending in 1 has its substitution block marker forced. The cited Goč–Mousavi–Shallit unbordered construction, reversal lemma and exactly-two theorem identify the unique two factors; each occurrence iff its parent occurrence under b-fold dilation and residue b-1 or d. Iteration gives exact sets including n=2, n multiple of b, and d=b-1. The count of odd b-adic valuations yields density 1/(b+1) for ones and b/(b+1) for Z_b; no adjacent ones yields gaps 1 or 2 and asymptotic proportions. An independent valuation-word enumeration verified occurrence equality for b=3,4,5, n=2..29, both orientations, all starts <2900; these are finite diagnostics, not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Goč–Mousavi–Shallit (2012) prove exactly two unbordered factors and their construction for generalized period-doubling words, so neither their count nor reversal is new. The marker iff recursion determines all starting positions and exact common return-gap sequence, not stated in that factor classification. Huang–Wen (2016) gives detailed return words for base-two period-doubling, and the submission excludes base two. Other generalized-base antisquare occurrence tables concern different short factors and do not cover arbitrary unbordered n.

value.rationale: Exact occurrence locations, densities, and gap sequences for every unbordered length in a natural automatic word family give quantitative recurrence information unavailable from a classification of which factors exist. The common normalized gap sequence across unbounded n is structurally motivated and nontrivial.

final_claim: For every integer generalized base b>=3 and n>=2, the two reversed unbordered factors of the valuation-parity period-doubling word have exact occurrence sets b^h Z_b+r_n^{+/-}, h=ceil(log_b n), density 1/((b+1)*b^(h-1)), and a common normalized sequence of gaps 1 and 2 with long-gap frequency 1/b.
limitations: Theorem concerns only b>=3, n>=2 and unbordered factors; cited 2012 classification not independently reproved.
residual_risks: Additional return-word results for composite generalized bases may be unindexed.
